rows.oracle: Packed dependency inspection shows core isolation and only CLI→core and MCP→core package edges.
Package exports expose only the root dispatcher contract and architecture checks find no deep imports or cycles.
Every operation returns exactly one success/value or structured failure and adapter cross-traces preserve it.
Schema/catalog operation variants and order are exact and any other operation fails unsupported_operation.
Validation returns exact Workflow or ordered failure while disk snapshots show no durable write.
Run creation returns exact identity/input facts and atomically publishes only the complete immutable Run.
Exact-ID inspection returns validated state, results, attempts, and lock facts without repair or latest inference.
Resume or one-node refresh returns no more than the bounded deterministic packets and creates no durable state.
Each binding read returns only its exact whole Workflow Input or Markdown/conditional-JSON Result bytes.
Eligible candidate submission publishes exact authoritative metadata and every invalid/stale candidate commits nothing.
Every expected failure uses a cataloged kind/code with bounded non-normative text and ordered diagnostics.
Every prepared packet conforms to its closed-world schema and contains all required identity, task, policy, Input, Result, and limit facts.
Packet/schema inspection finds none of the forbidden content, authority, command, unrelated-context, final-path, or allocated-attempt fields.
Candidate schema and contextual validation enforce exact echoed identity, status-specific JSON/problem rules, and no authoritative metadata.
Resume limits 1–3 and refresh limit 1 select exact topology/authored-order packets; all other shapes fail.
Duplicate preparation changes nothing; serialized submission accepts only still-eligible work and never performs hidden retry.
Trusted cancellation obeys publication semantics and core process/network/model/agent duration sentinels remain untouched.
Every shared six-operation trace has identical decoded values, failures, ordering, limits, and disk effects through each transport sequence.
